# Jens Kjeldsen

Jens Kjeldsen is a Danish medical professional who serves as a chief physician, professor, and PhD, representing the Region of Southern Denmark (Region Syddanmark) [^src1]. He is a member of the steering committee for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. His position on the committee underscores his professional authority in the field of gastroenterology and highlights the integration of regional clinical leadership into Denmark's national quality registers [^src1].

Within the broader context of the 2023 DANIBD annual report, the steering committee functions as the strategic management unit for the registry [^src1]. This committee oversees a national initiative aimed at systematizing and improving the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) across Denmark [^src1]. Through cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and the evidence-based development of treatment guidelines, the committee utilizes detailed quality data to drive clinical benchmarking, evaluate treatment access, and identify implementation challenges for quality indicators such as patient education and the use of biologics or small molecules [^src1].
